# 💀 iGGAdPopupBlock

#### AD Blocker for [iGameGod](https://igamegod.app/) & [iOSGods App+](https://iosgods.com/topic/153130-introducing-igamegod-jailed-speed-manager-touch-recorder-cheat-engine-for-non-jailbroken-devices/#comment-4937789) Apps

**`iGGAdPopupBlock`** is a lightweight, sideload-safe dynamic library (.dylib) engineered to suppress forced popup and interstitial ads generated by [iGameGod](https://igamegod.app/) on jailed and jailbroken iOS devices.

> ✅
> Verified running on a jailed iPhone 17  with iOS 27.
>
 
## Features

### Zero Substrate Dependency: 

No hard or soft linkage requirements on CydiaSubstrate or libsubstrate

### Supported tools include:

- [iOSGods App+](https://app.iosgods.com/): Custom dylib injection platform

> App+ users are advised to rename IGGAdPopupBlock.dylib prior to injection to
> bypass potential filename-based filtering mechanisms. See [best practices](https://github.com/gemsloot-iOS/iGGAdPopupBlock/edit/main/README.md#renaming-guidance--filename-filtering-avoidance) for more info.
>

- [KSign](https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign): Local signing utility supporting dynamic library insertion 

- [Feather](https://github.com/claration/feather): IPA signing and installation tool
 
- [ESign](https://github.com/iOS17/Esign): On-device code signing and certificate manager 

- **Zero UI Hang:** Main-queue execution keeps gameplay smooth and responsive.

> **⚠️ CRITICAL — HOW TO ACTIVATE:** 
> **Zero ad blocking is active when you first launch the app.** 
> You **MUST take ONE in-app screenshot** after opening the game to arm and activate the ad blocker. Until you take that screenshot, ads will NOT be blocked.

## Quick Start

1. Download `IGGAdPopupBlock.dylib` from the [Releases](../../releases) page.
   - *Pro Tip for **iOSGods App+** users:* Rename `IGGAdPopupBlock.dylib` to any random name (e.g., `GameFix.dylib`) before injecting it via App+ Custom Dylibs so it can't be filename-filtered.
2. Inject `IGGAdPopupBlock.dylib` into your target IPA using **KSign**, **Feather**, **App+** or **ESign**.
3. Sign, install, and open the app.
4. Take **one screenshot** in-game to arm and complete hook activation (`INST DONE`).

> ⚠️ iOSGods App+ Users ⚠️
> >
> I highly recommend you follow these best practices to maintain maximum compatibility.
> 

### Renaming Guidance & Filename Filtering Avoidance 

iOSGods App+ may implement automated string matching or filename-based blacklisting to detect and filter out known ad-blockers, telemetry tools, or cheat engines.

Keeping the default filename `IGGAdPopupBlock.` has the potential to trigger automated filters that reject or strip the dylib during the signing or installation phases. 

### Best Practices for Filename Obfuscation:

Avoid Keyword Matching: Strip terms like ad, block, popup, igamegod, or cheat from the filename.

Generic Naming: Rename the library to innocuous utility names (e.g., GameFix.dylib or CoreSupport.dylib) prior to passing it to the injection interface.
